# `read_workspace_source`

[Back to the MCP API router](../../mcp-api.md)

Read bounded source evidence from an exact logical user add-on workspace path returned by workspace symbol tools. The revision-bound snapshot is owned by the language engine and never exposes a physical path.

### Annotations

```json
{
  "title": "Read workspace source",
  "readOnlyHint": true,
  "openWorldHint": false
}
```

### Stable failures

Workspace tools return structured tool errors with a stable code and retry guidance. They never expose physical workspace paths or Workbench log references.
